distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；江西；四川；云南；浙江；台湾
distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) recognizes Scolytoplatypus sinensis as a distinct species and reports examined mainland records from Chongqing, Fujian, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Zhejiang. The source also acknowledges earlier Taiwan records, which are retained in current regional occurrence.

host_note: Direct/examined source evidence supports Cinnamomum cassia and C. camphora. Additional host records Alnus cremastogyne, Amygdalus davidiana, Phoebe zhennan and Theaceae are literature-context records and are retained separately.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus sinensis Tsai & Huang, 1965.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus sinensis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Liao et al. (2022) resurrects Scolytoplatypus sinensis Tsai & Huang, 1965 from synonymy with S. mikado. Stable identity VSN_5443 is retained.
